verdict.rationale: CDP documents an off-ramp path from stablecoins to bank accounts. Stablecoins received to a custodial account can be auto-liquidated or auto-converted to USD, then sent out over ACH, Fedwire, Swift or SEPA. Offramp separately covers converting crypto earnings to fiat and depositing them to bank accounts. However, the evidence shows only those four named rails, which point to USD and EUR, not a published list of supported local currencies and countries. Missing for 10: a published currency/country coverage list, evidence of local-currency payout beyond USD/EUR rails, and independent or hands-on corroboration of off-ramp payouts.
